goal: Make open_role in gateway/mcp_client.py accept a list of profile names and open one session per profile, and add a unit test for it.
requirements: A string profile opens once, as before; None opens no profile session.
A list profile is normalised to a list, and each name is opened once with open_profile, in order.
Do not change gateway/personas.yaml or gateway/config.py.
The new test in tests/ calls open_role with a two-element list, mocks open_profile so no Docker is needed, and asserts open_profile was called once per name.
context: open_profile takes a single profile name. The devops role in gateway/personas.yaml uses profile [build, analyze, debug], so the list reaches open_profile and fails with an argument error. Keep the change minimal.
